description: Hydraulic, wash-off and sediment transport experiments in a full-scale urban drainage physical model is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Juan Naves et al. This paper presents a dataset obtained from hydraulic and sediment transport experiments performed in a full-scale urban drainage physical model of 36 m2. Coverage: not stated; published in 2020. Formats: CSV, Image, Point cloud. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
